component.name: Devmode
component.summary: Manage repos and group them into workspaces

description.p: Devmode is a project management utility for developers. It helps you manage repositories and group them into workspaces.

ul.li: Track repos you clone, create, or already have on disk in a local registry.
Lay out cloned repos automatically under a configurable root.
Group repos into workspaces with their own editor and environment.
Open every repo in a workspace with a single command.
Track repositories you clone, create, or already have on disk in a local registry.
Lay cloned repositories out automatically under a configurable root, with built-in or custom naming conventions.
Group repositories into non-destructive workspaces, each with its own default editor and environment variables.
Open every repository in a workspace at once.
